## 更新内容 / Changes

- 加固 Codex 桌面兼容性验证：烟测现在按已安装客户端实际探测到的能力运行，未知版本或缺失的可选能力会独立跳过，不再因版本登记或不存在的模型菜单使验证失败。
- 发送控件兼容中文、英文和启用的提交按钮；客户端未注入语言资源时仍可验证请求发送。
- 修正实例启动预览文案，明确区分 OAuth 身份 + 本地 API 网关与纯 API 凭据，避免把“API 模式”误解为必然没有账号显示。
- 保留 `v0.5.0` 中的动态能力探测、OAuth 身份与本地 API 混合模式、实例生命周期恢复和退出时保留运行实例的行为。

- Hardened Codex desktop compatibility verification: the smoke test now follows the capabilities discovered in the installed client. Unknown versions and missing optional capabilities are skipped independently, so a new client does not fail because a version entry or model menu is absent.
- Send controls support Chinese, English and enabled submit buttons, so request delivery remains verifiable when locale resources are unavailable.
- Clarified the instance launch preview so OAuth identity plus the Local API gateway is distinguished from a pure API credential, avoiding the assumption that API mode can never show an account.
- Retains the dynamic capability detection, OAuth identity plus Local API hybrid mode, instance recovery and background-preserving quit behavior from `v0.5.0`.

## 下载与升级 / Downloads and upgrades

提供 macOS Apple Silicon（arm64）的 DMG / ZIP，附件包含 `SHA256SUMS.txt`。关闭管理器窗口不会停止运行中的实例；实例全部结束并完成配置回收后管理器才会退出。账号、实例、会话和本地配置保留。应用内自动更新尚未接入，安装包未进行 Developer ID 签名或公证。

DMG and ZIP packages are provided for macOS Apple Silicon (arm64), with `SHA256SUMS.txt`. Closing the manager window does not stop running instances; the manager exits after all instances finish and their configuration is restored. Accounts, instances, sessions and local settings are retained. In-app automatic updates, Developer ID signing and notarization are not included.

## 客户端支持 / Client support

当前支持 Codex，客户端需单独安装。Claude Code 与 Claude Desktop（Chat / Cowork / Code）为计划功能，尚未接入。兼容能力依赖已安装 Codex 的实际结构、账号身份、套餐、模型和服务商；管理器不会把纯 API 凭据显示成 ChatGPT 登录。

Codex is currently supported and must be installed separately. Claude Code and Claude Desktop (Chat / Cowork / Code) are planned, not implemented. Compatibility depends on the installed Codex structure, account identity, plan, model and provider; the manager does not display a pure API credential as a ChatGPT login.

## 验证来源 / Verification

版本标签 `v0.5.1` 对应本次完整来源提交。GitHub Actions “Build release” 会运行公开仓库检查、macOS arm64 源码测试、打包检查并生成附件校验值。安装包校验值见附件 `SHA256SUMS.txt`。

The `v0.5.1` tag identifies the complete source commit for this maintenance release. GitHub Actions “Build release” runs the public repository check, macOS arm64 source tests, packaging checks and installer checksum generation. Installer hashes are provided in the attached `SHA256SUMS.txt`.
